title: 第1668章 焚墟金炎兽死第1667章 一起被吞
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 郑元一脸尴尬，谁曾想到那金炎之火把两人的衣服都烧成灰烬了。
那会发生的太快了，好在后来郑元及时用凤灵真火护住了两人。
否则这会都要烧死在一起变成灰烬了。
好在郑元和金素梅一起穿过了烈焰滚滚。
“呜呜呜……混蛋，死淫贼，本姑娘以后还怎么见人？”
金素梅蹲在地上，捂着脸哭的稀里哗啦，这下子清白之躯全没了。
“咳咳，乖弟子，你放心，这件事情老祖一定烂在肚子里，绝不会说出去，老祖我以道心发誓……”
“其实还有一个办法，那就是嫁给老祖我，放心，老祖我一定会对你负责到底的……”
郑元竖起手掌发完誓言后，一脸笑意盈盈。
反正两人都坦诚相对了，这丫头将来不嫁给自己还能嫁给谁。
况且这丫头身材凹凸有致，肌肤白皙粉嫩如玉，一双修长的玉腿完美无瑕。
“呸，休想！”
金素梅嗖的一下子站了起来，俏脸涨的通红一片。
死淫贼一定早就垂涎自己的身子了，绝不能让他得逞。
“咦？这是什么东西？”
就在下一刻，金素梅眼睛一亮，那就是发现了金炎兽的内丹。
犹如拳头般大小，周身散发着一道道金炎。
这可是好东西，尤其是对金乌族之人来说。
金炎兽吞噬金乌族之人来提升金炎，反之，它的内丹同样能反哺金乌族之人。
只不过金炎兽力大无比，兽躯坚硬，浑身上下没有一丝破绽。
想要弄到金炎兽的内丹简直比登天还难。
这枚内丹没准能帮助自己突破真神境界呢。
金素梅手里的长剑猛的向着那颗内丹底部削了过去。
叮的一声响，金素梅突然傻眼了，那就是一道火光四溅，自己的长剑反而被弹飞了出去。
叮叮当当！
一阵叮当响声过后。
金素梅也不由倒吸一口冷气，没想到这内丹太结实了。
就在下一刻，一道金光闪过，咔嚓一声响。
“乖弟子，送你了。”
郑元用昊天神矛把金炎兽内丹一下子切了下来，一脸笑眯眯的递了过去。
“死淫贼，本姑娘才不要你的东西呢。”
金素梅咬着嘴唇，一脸气鼓鼓的模样。
一看到这张笑脸，就又想起了自己被死淫贼看个精光的情形了。
如今还不知道怎么办，在金炎兽的体内还不知道能不能逃出去，即使逃出去，自己也打不过死淫贼，更不用说杀他了。
就在此时，两人脚下突然猛的剧烈晃动了起来。
此时上古凶兽金炎兽嘴里发出阵阵哀嚎声，内丹被摘下，庞大的身躯瞬间失去了力量核心。
通体翻滚的金色烈焰以肉眼可见的速度黯淡下去，庞大的兽躯疯狂抽搐震颤。
整片血肉洞府跟着疯狂摇晃，地面大幅度倾斜，两人根本站立不稳，瞬间失去平衡，再度紧紧纠缠着翻滚在一起了。
噗嗤！
content_en:
Zheng Yuan looked embarrassed. Who would have thought that the golden flames would burn their clothes to ashes.
That happened too fast. Fortunately, Zheng Yuan used Fengling True Fire to protect the two of them in time.
Otherwise, they will all be burned together and turned into ashes.
Fortunately, Zheng Yuan and Jin Sumei passed through the rolling flames together.
"Uuuuuuuuah...bastard, you damn thief, how can I see anyone else in the future?"
Jin Sumei squatted on the ground, covering her face and crying, her innocence completely gone.
"Ahem, good disciple, don't worry, my ancestor will definitely keep this matter in his stomach and will never tell it. I swear, ancestor, with my Taoist heart..."
"Actually, there is another way, and that is to marry me, ancestor. Don't worry, ancestor, I will be responsible for you to the end..."
Zheng Yuan raised his palms and finished his oath with a smile on his face.
Anyway, both of them were honest with each other. Who else could this girl marry in the future if she didn't marry herself?
Besides, this girl has a curvy figure, her skin is as fair and pink as jade, and her slender legs are flawless.
"Bah, don't even think about it!"
Jin Sumei suddenly stood up, her pretty face flushed.
The evil thief must have coveted his body for a long time, and he must not be allowed to succeed.
"Huh? What is this?"
The next moment, Jin Sumei's eyes lit up, that is, she discovered the inner elixir of the Golden Flame Beast.
It was as big as a fist, with streaks of golden flames emitting from its entire body.
This is a good thing, especially for people from the Golden Crow tribe.
The Golden Flame Beast devours the people of the Golden Crow Tribe to enhance the Golden Flame. On the contrary, its inner elixir can also feed back the people of the Golden Crow Tribe.
It's just that the Golden Flame Beast is extremely powerful, its body is hard, and there is no flaw in its body.
Getting the inner elixir of the Golden Flame Beast is simply as difficult as climbing to the sky.
This inner elixir might help him break through to the realm of true gods.
The long sword in Jin Sumei's hand sharply slashed towards the bottom of the inner elixir.
There was a ding sound, and Jin Sumei was suddenly dumbfounded. There was a burst of fire, and her long sword was bounced away.
Ding-ding-ding-ding!
After a jingling sound.
Hiss...
Jin Sumei couldn't help but take a breath of air. She didn't expect that the inner elixir was so strong.
At the next moment, a golden light flashed and there was a click.
"Good disciple, I'll give it to you."
Zheng Yuan used the Haotian Divine Spear to cut off the inner elixir of the Golden Flame Beast at once, and handed it over with a smile on his face.
"You damn thief, I don't want anything from you."
Jin Sumei bit her lip, looking angry.
As soon as I saw this smiling face, I remembered the time when I was stared at by a dead lewd thief.
Now I don't know what to do. I don't know if I can escape from the Golden Flame Beast's body. Even if I escape, I won't be able to defeat the lewd thief, let alone kill him.
At this moment, the feet of the two men suddenly shook violently.
At this time, the ancient fierce beast Golden Flame Beast let out bursts of wailing sounds from its mouth. The inner elixir was removed, and its huge body instantly lost its core of power.
The rolling golden flames dimmed at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the huge beast's body twitched and trembled crazily.
The entire cave of flesh and blood shook wildly, and the ground tilted greatly. The two of them were unable to stand steadily. They lost their balance in an instant and were once again entangled and tumbling together.
Poof!
title_en: Chapter 1668 The Death of the Burning Ruins Golden Flame Beast Chapter 1667 Being Swallowed Together
